Lost in Inference: Rediscovering the Role of Natural Language Inference for Large Language Models
Lovish MadaanAffiliation: University College LondonEmail: lovish@meta.comDavid EsiobuEmail: dieuwkehupkes@meta.comPontus StenetorpAffiliation: University College LondonAffiliation: Research and Development Center for LLMs, National Institute of InformaticsBarbara PlankAffiliation: MaiNLP, Center for Information and Language Processing, LMU Munich, GermanyAffiliation: Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML), Munich, GermanyDieuwke HupkesMeta
Abstract
In the recent past, a popular way of evaluating natural language understanding (NLU), was to consider a model’s ability to perform natural language inference (NLI) tasks.
In this paper, we investigate if NLI tasks, that are rarely used for LLM evaluation, can still be informative for evaluating LLMs.
